description:
Position to fill: Senior Backend Web Developer

Industry IT services

Location: NYC

Salary range: US$100k -$135k base with stock options

Job Description:

Are you looking for a challenging start up environment where you can be at the edge of 

the FinTech revolution?

Are you looking for a place to demonstrate your well-honed coding skills and be a part of 

the disruptive FinTech scene?

Well look no further; our client is a FinTech start up creating cutting edge technological 

products using the Blockchain for the securities and trading space. 

Backend Web Developers, NYC

You bring:

 Extensive experience with Javascript, CSS, HTML. Experience with jQuery

 Experience with modern, popular web frameworks like Angular, Ember, and 

React.js

 1.5+ years experience with Python and Flask (or 2.5+ years experience with 

similar web framework, and some experience with Python)

 Extensive experience with SQL, APIs (REST, JSON-RPC, etc), Git/GitHub (or 

similar RCS)

 1+ years experience with Linux (Ubuntu and Bash experience preferred)

 Live in the United States and would be open to relocating to the NYC metro 

area within 6-9 months

Highly Recommended:

 Previous UI/UX design experience

 Experience with Test-Driven Development, unit testing & functional testing, 

Scrum/XP/Agile

Nice to Have:

 Previous Bitcoin development experience (or minimally, respectable knowledge 

and experience with public key cryptography and cryptographic systems)

 Experience (or at a minimum, familiarity) with the other tools and technology 

(beyond Flask, Angular, Python, etc) powering our stack: RabbitMQ/Celery, 

PostgreSQL, Redis, HAProxy, Nginx, Jquery, Selenium, Travis, 

Docker/fig/Ansible, Wiki/Restructured text, AWS, NoSQL 

(Mongo/Cassandra/etc), Pingdom.

 Previous Financial Technology (FinTech) experience — experience working with 

financial systems’ UI/UX.                       

Keys / Comments:

Must be open to relocating to NYC if not living 

there already.
 

 


 Job Status: Full Time 

Share the Profiles to paramesh(at)tammina.com

 Contact: 703 349 2332 

Keep the subject line with Job Title and Location
